sn22.73:1.2: “Bhikkhus, the uninstructed worldling does not understand as it really is the gratification, the danger,
sn22.73:1.6: and the escape in the case of form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.
sn22.73:1.7: “But, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple understands as it really is the gratification, the danger,
sn22.73:1.11: and the escape in the case of form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.”
